notes: COMPAS's own sources. They are registered whether or not the demo seed runs.
compas-analyst is the AI analyst. It may only FLAG, and revoke its own flags when a human reviewer withdraws them. A flag turns a declared category into REVIEW; it never adds support.

compas-onboarding/merchant records what a merchant asserts itself while onboarding, such as the NIT on the certificate it uploaded. Its binding is self-declared: a registry claim joined through it is REGISTRY_UNBOUND.
